_comment: Internal-link policy for the BLOCKING step in .github/workflows/doc-lint.yml.
Every http(s) URL is ignored here, leaving relative file targets and heading
anchors — the links Doctrine actually controls. This check needs no network,
so it is deterministic and safe to gate on.
External URLs are covered separately and advisorily by
.markdown-link-check.json; third-party availability is not a property of
Doctrine, and hosts such as docs.ansible.com answer CI clients with 429 or
